memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "The men had been seated before him in the order of their ages, from the firstborn to the youngest; and they looked at each other in astonishment." - Gen 43:33 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
A small mystery unsettles the brothers at the feast. They find themselves seated exactly in the order of their ages, "from the firstborn to the youngest." How could this Egyptian ruler possibly know their birth order? There was no way a stranger should have such knowledge of their family. They "looked at each other in astonishment," sensing something uncanny about this man, though they could not explain it.

Of course, we know the secret: Joseph knew them intimately because he was their brother. He knew each of them, in order, because they were his own family. What seemed impossible knowledge to them was simply the knowledge of one who knew them fully and loved them.

There is a gentle reflection here about being fully known. The brothers were amazed that someone knew them so well. But there is One who knows each of us far more deeply than Joseph knew his brothers — our Maker, who formed us, numbers our days, and knows even the hairs on our head (Ps 139; Matt 10:30). Nothing about us is hidden from Him.

For some, being fully known is frightening; for the child of God, it is a comfort. The God who knows us completely also loves us completely. We are not anonymous to Him, not a face in the crowd, but each one known, named, and cherished. Rest in this: you are fully known by the God who fully loves you. Like Joseph knowing his brothers, He knows you — and He draws near not to expose you, but to bless you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. How does it feel to be fully known by God?
2. Is being known by God a fear or a comfort to me?
3. How does God's intimate knowledge of me shape my sense of worth?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You know me completely — every detail of my life is open before You. Thank You that the God who fully knows me also fully loves me. Help me to rest in being known and cherished by You. Amen.
